Where to Stay in Rayong?

heroSub: 12 hand-picked Rayong hotels across every budget — from 5-star pool villas on Koh Samet down to a Ban Phe pier dorm from ฿450/night. Covering the main areas: Koh Samet, Mae Ramphueng, Mae Phim and Rayong Town. From roughly ฿450–12,000/night.
heroStats: 🏝️ 4 key areas (Koh Samet·Mae Ramphueng·Mae Phim·Rayong Town)
introH2: 🏝️ Why does choosing the right area in Rayong matter so much?
introHtml: Rayong isn't only Koh Samet, and each area feels very different. Koh Samet is the headline — white-sand beaches and clear water — but the island itself splits into several bays: Hat Sai Kaew is lively with restaurants and nightlife, while Ao Prao, Ao Kiu, Ao Thapthim and Ao Wong Duean are quieter and more private, and some can only be reached by the resort's own speedboat. On the mainland, Mae Ramphueng Beach is drivable and close to town, Mae Phim Beach (Klaeng district) is a long quiet beach you can drive right up to, and Rayong Town isn't on the sea but is cheap and handy for a work trip or a stopover. Many people book without checking which bay needs a boat, then lose time getting around the island. This guide rounds up 12 Rayong hotels we've already reviewed across every tier — with real guest-review scores, a 3-site price comparison and direct booking links for each.
mrtHtml: Rayong has no metro; you mostly get around by car. Stays on Koh Samet require a boat from Ban Phe Pier — passenger boats to Hat Sai Kaew take around 30–40 min, while resorts on Ao Prao and Ao Kiu run their own speedboats (about 15–20 min). Mainland stays such as Mae Ramphueng Beach and Rayong Town you simply drive to. From U-Tapao Airport (UTP) it's about 45–60 min to Ban Phe Pier; from Bangkok it's roughly a 3-hour drive. The areas in this guide: Koh Samet — white sand, clear water, several bays (Sai Kaew·Ao Prao·Ao Kiu·Ao Thapthim·Ao Wong Duean) · Mae Ramphueng Beach — drivable, near town · Mae Phim Beach — long and quiet, Klaeng district · Rayong Town — cheap, handy for a work trip or stopover.

entries.name: Paradee Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Kiu · southern tip of Koh Samet · speedboat transfer
entries.addr: 76 Moo 4, Ao Kiu, Koh Samet, Phe, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: The top score in this guide at 9.4 — Paradee is a 5-star luxury resort of 40 pool villas at Ao Kiu, the southern tip of Koh Samet that cars can't reach, so you arrive by the resort's own speedboat from Ban Phe. That's exactly what keeps the beach so quiet and private. Real guest reviews praise the attentive service, the near-empty beach and the large, airy villas, though some mention plastic litter drifting in from other parts of the island and the remote location making it hard to go out. TripAdvisor ranks it #1 of 24 hotels on Koh Samet. Best for couples and honeymooners who want to switch off completely.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: check speedboat times in advance and reach Ban Phe Pier at least 30 minutes early — miss a run and you wait for the next. If the budget allows, the Beach Front Pool Villa with an infinity pool opening onto the sand is the highlight here.
pros: Top score in the guide, 9.4 · TripAdvisor #1 on Koh Samet
Very quiet private beach, almost no other tourists
Attentive service with care for the small details
Spacious pool villas, some with infinity pools onto the sea
cons: Highest price in the guide — best for a special trip or honeymoon
At the island's tip — hard to reach other beaches or go out at night

entries.name: Le Vimarn Cottages & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Prao Beach · west coast of Koh Samet · boat transfer
entries.addr: 40/11 Moo 4, Ao Prao, Phe, Mueang Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Le Vimarn is a 5-star Samed Resorts property on Ao Prao Beach, on Koh Samet's quieter west coast, with 31 hillside cottages and villas, scoring 9.3. The draw is Ao Prao itself — quieter than Hat Sai Kaew, with water clear enough to snorkel coral straight off the beach — plus sea views from rooms set into the slope, many with a terrace soaking tub. Real guest reviews praise staff who remember your name and the woodwork that blends into the hillside, while noting you must take a resort speedboat into Ao Prao, in-resort drinks are pricey, and the bay is so quiet there's almost nothing outside the resort. TripAdvisor #2 on Koh Samet. Best for couples and honeymooners.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: pick an Ocean Hillside room or a villa with a terrace tub — the elevated sea view is the highlight. Bring your own snorkel gear to save on rental, and confirm the speedboat schedule with the resort before reaching the pier.
pros: Quiet Ao Prao with clear water — snorkel coral off the beach
Hillside cottages with sea views, many with a terrace tub
Excellent, friendly service — staff remember your name
TripAdvisor #2 on Koh Samet · score 9.3
cons: Must take a resort speedboat into Ao Prao — allow time
Pricey drinks; quiet bay with almost nothing outside the resort

entries.name: Rayong Marriott Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Wang Kaew Beach · Klaeng · drive to the beachfront
entries.storyHtml: Rayong Marriott is a 5-star Marriott beachfront resort on Wang Kaew Beach in Klaeng that you can drive right up to — no boat needed — and it's the most-reviewed 5-star here at 508 reviews, scoring 9.0. The draw is a long private beach, three saltwater pools and acres of space for kids to roam all day. Real guest reviews praise the size of the grounds, the breakfast and the international brand standards, while noting the remote location with little nearby and some parts starting to show their age. Best for families who want a private beach and several pools with big-chain reliability.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: the Deluxe Ocean View and up is worth it if you want the sea view. Plan to eat in the resort or bring supplies, since there isn't much within easy reach outside.
pros: Most-reviewed here, 508 · consistent Marriott standards
Drive right up to the beachfront — no boat
Long private beach, three saltwater pools — family-friendly
Huge grounds for kids all day · good breakfast
cons: Remote location with little nearby outside the resort
Older property — some parts showing their age

entries.name: Sai Kaew Beach Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Hat Sai Kaew · Koh Samet · the liveliest beach
tags: 🏖️ On Hat Sai Kaew, walk to everything
entries.addr: Hat Sai Kaew, Koh Samet, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Sai Kaew is a 4-star Samed Resorts property right on Hat Sai Kaew, and the most-reviewed hotel in this guide — 581 reviews, scoring 9.0. The draw is a central Hat Sai Kaew location where you can walk to everything — the sea, restaurants and nightlife — plus three pools and an evening live-music fire show. Real guest reviews praise the location and convenience, while being clear that Hat Sai Kaew is the busiest beach on the island and some room zones still await renovation. Best for those who want to be in the thick of Koh Samet's buzz.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a quieter night, ask for an inner-zone room away from the music stage and beachfront. You can take a passenger boat from Ban Phe straight to Hat Sai Kaew — no special speedboat needed like at Ao Prao.
pros: Most-reviewed in the guide, 581 — solid, reliable data
On Hat Sai Kaew — walk to restaurants and everything
Three pools, plus a Family Pool Residence
Live music and an evening fire show — fun atmosphere
cons: Hat Sai Kaew is the island's busiest beach — packed in high season
Some room zones still await renovation

entries.name: Tubtim Resort
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Thapthim · Koh Samet · walk straight into the sea
tags: 🌅 Walk to the sea from your porch
entries.storyHtml: Tubtim Resort is a wooden-bungalow resort right on quiet Ao Thapthim beach, with the highest score in the mid-to-value tier at 9.2. The draw is the white sand of Ao Thapthim, where you can walk straight into the sea from your porch, traditional Thai wooden bungalows and a restaurant by the waves. Real guest reviews praise the beachfront setting and the easy-going island feel, but are honest that the resort has run since 1981 — the bungalows are rustic and some show their age — and reviews are still few (43). Best for those who like an old-school island vibe at an accessible price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a sea view on waking, pick a Beachfront / Sea View Bungalow. The bungalows are rustic — come for the atmosphere rather than newness. Take a boat from Ban Phe to Hat Sai Kaew, then a ride or short walk to Ao Thapthim.
pros: High score 9.2 — best in the mid-to-value tier
On quiet Ao Thapthim — white sand, walk into the sea
Traditional Thai wooden bungalows, natural island feel
Restaurant by the waves · from an accessible ฿1,800
cons: Long-running and rustic — some bungalows show their age
Few reviews (43) compared with others in this guide

entries.name: Ao Prao Resort
entries.badge: 🤿 Ao Prao for a lighter budget
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Prao Beach · west coast of Koh Samet · boat transfer
tags: 💰 4-star Ao Prao on a lighter budget
entries.storyHtml: Ao Prao Resort is a 4-star Samed Resorts boutique property on the same Ao Prao bay as Le Vimarn, but starting at a lighter price, scoring 9.0 from 190 reviews. The draw is the same quiet, clear-water Ao Prao with snorkelling off the beach and hillside rooms with sea views, at a price more reachable than the luxury resort on the same bay. Real guest reviews praise the beach and the value, while noting the boat transfer into Ao Prao and that some rooms still await renovation. Best for those who want the Ao Prao feel without paying 5-star rates.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a sea view, step up to Premier Sea View or a Beachfront Cottage. Ask for a renovated room, since some are older, and confirm the Ao Prao boat schedule with the resort before reaching the pier.
pros: The quiet, clear-water Ao Prao on a lighter budget
Snorkel coral off the beach · hillside rooms with sea views
Samed Resorts — good service standards
Consistent 9.0 from 190 reviews

entries.storyHtml: Kantary Bay is a 4-star hotel and serviced apartment by Mae Ramphueng Beach on the mainland — drivable, with in-room kitchens, scoring 9.0 from 157 reviews. The draw is spacious apartment-style rooms with kitchens, two pools and plenty of activities, ideal for families or longer stays, with food and convenience stores nearby. Real guest reviews praise the room size and value, while noting Mae Ramphueng is a public beach across the road, some rooms are older and there can be road noise. Best for families wanting a beachfront kitchen room at a friendly price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a family or long stay, pick a One/Two Bedroom Premier Suite with a full kitchen — cheaper than eating out every meal. Ask for a room away from the road to avoid traffic noise.

entries.name: Vimarn Samed Resort
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.0 · 148 reviews · clifftop, sea on three sides
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ao Wong Duean · Koh Samet · on a headland
tags: 🚶 Walk to two beaches in minutes

entries.addr: Ao Wong Duean, Koh Samet, Rayong
entries.storyHtml: Vimarn Samed is a sea-view resort on a headland between Ao Phai and Ao Wong Duean, with the sea on three sides, scoring 9.0 from 148 reviews. The draw is wide-open sea views from the balcony, a pool facing the sea, and a short walk to both Ao Phai and Ao Wong Duean beaches. Real guest reviews praise the views and the calm, while noting that the resort sits on a cliff rather than right on the sand, some rooms show their age, and opinions on breakfast are mixed. Best for those who love an elevated sea view at a value price.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: choose a Deluxe Bungalow Sea View or up for the full sea view. Accept that you'll walk down a slope to the beach — the resort is on a clifftop, not on the sand.

Pool facing the sea, calm atmosphere
Walk to Ao Phai and Ao Wong Duean in minutes

cons: On a clifftop, not right on the sand — a walk down the slope
Some rooms show their age · mixed reviews on breakfast

entries.name: Star Convention Hotel

entries.storyHtml: Star Convention is a 4-star city hotel in Rayong Town with big rooms, where you can walk down into the Star IT Center mall, scoring 8.8 from 123 reviews. The draw is larger-than-standard rooms, good breakfast, two pools, a gym and sauna — handy for work, conference, transit or longer stays. Real guest reviews praise the room size and value, but are honest that the building is older and this isn't a beach resort: if you've come for the sea, you'll need to drive on to Ban Phe or Mae Ramphueng. Best for budget-minded travellers using the town as a base.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: use it as a town base and drive out to the sea during the day. For a family, the Family Suite is the better-value pick, and the Star IT Center mall is right downstairs for food and supplies.

Best for those who want a quiet drivable beach in the 4-star bracket.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a sea view on waking, pick a Deluxe Ocean Facing room. Mae Phim is long and quiet — lovely for a morning walk — and ask for a renovated room since some areas are older.

entries.storyHtml: Banphe Hostel is the cheapest stay in this guide — dorms from just ฿450 — right next to Ban Phe Pier, scoring 8.9 from 66 reviews. The draw is being closest to the pier, so you can walk straight onto the boat to Koh Samet, plus a warm hands-on owner, a shared kitchen and free bikes. Real guest reviews praise the location and the owner's care, while being clear that the building is older, fan rooms get hot and bathrooms are shared. Best for budget travellers crossing to Koh Samet who want to sleep right by the pier.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ideal for a single night by the pier before crossing. If you can't take the heat, pick the air-con private triple. Use the free bikes to explore around Ban Phe.

entries.name: Stay Samed
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.7 · 5 reviews · near Hat Sai Kaew

entries.storyHtml: Stay Samed is a value Koh Samet hostel within a few minutes' walk of Hat Sai Kaew and the pier, scoring 8.7. The draw is clean air-con dorms with privacy curtains and an in-house café serving all-day breakfast — ideal for solo travellers or backpackers who'd rather save on the room and spend on activities. Real guest reviews praise the clean dorms and the location, but are honest that reviews are still very few (5), it's not on the beach, there's no sea view from the rooms, and some private rooms look older than the photos. Best for budget-focused backpackers.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: solo travellers get the best value from the curtained air-con dorm; groups should take the Quadruple Room to split the cost. Note it's not on the beach — a 6-minute walk to Hat Sai Kaew.

faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Rayong hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in around Rayong?
faq.a: It depends on your style. Koh Samet is the headline — white sand and clear water — but the island splits into several bays: Hat Sai Kaew is lively with restaurants and nightlife (Sai Kaew, Stay Samed), while Ao Prao, Ao Kiu, Ao Thapthim and Ao Wong Duean are quieter and more private (Paradee, Le Vimarn, Ao Prao, Tubtim, Vimarn Samed). Mae Ramphueng and Mae Phim are mainland beaches you can drive right up to (Marriott, Kantary Bay, Centara Q). Rayong Town isn't on the sea but is cheap and good for a work trip (Star Convention; Banphe Hostel is by the pier).

faq.q: ❓ How much do Rayong hotels cost?
faq.a: A wide range: dorms and hostels start around ฿450–900/night; city hotels and mid-range to 4-star resorts run roughly ฿1,200–3,500; pool villas and 5-star luxury resorts on Koh Samet start around ฿4,500–12,000+. All figures are approximate from-rates for standard rooms; during High Season (Nov–Apr) and long holidays prices are well above normal.

faq.q: ❓ How do I get to Koh Samet, and does every stay need a boat?
faq.a: Stays on Koh Samet require a boat from Ban Phe Pier — passenger boats to Hat Sai Kaew take 30–40 min (Sai Kaew, Tubtim, Stay Samed), while resorts on Ao Prao and Ao Kiu run their own speedboats (about 15–20 min; Paradee, Le Vimarn, Ao Prao) — confirm schedules with the resort. Mainland stays such as Mae Ramphueng, Mae Phim and Rayong Town are simply drivable — no boat. From Bangkok it's about a 3-hour drive to Ban Phe; from U-Tapao Airport about 45–60 min.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Rayong hotel?
faq.a: On regular weekdays outside peak season, 2–4 weeks ahead is enough. But during High Season (November–April), especially New Year, Songkran and long holidays, pool villas and beachfront resorts on Koh Samet sell out fast — book 1–2 months ahead, particularly for sea-view rooms and the resort speedboat runs at Ao Prao and Ao Kiu.

faq.q: ❓ I want a Rayong beach trip but no boat — where can I stay?
faq.a: There are mainland options you can drive right up to: Rayong Marriott Resort & Spa on Wang Kaew Beach (Klaeng) with a long private beach; Centara Q Resort Rayong on the long quiet Mae Phim Beach (Klaeng); and Kantary Bay Hotel Rayong by Mae Ramphueng Beach near town. All three need no boat — ideal if you're driving or simply don't want to cross to the island.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Rayong hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) vary by promotion and date, so open all three and compare before every booking — each review page in this guide has the price-comparison links. It can save you several hundred to over a thousand baht per night in peak periods.
